cluster_contents: both models plus all roles/conditions for the item

primary.per_model: P(final incorrect|directed, initial correct)-P(final incorrect|neutral, initial correct)
primary.complete_pair_requirement: valid initial plus valid neutral and directed finals

model_interaction: exploratory only and requires a direct interaction estimate

interpretation_rules.ci_above_zero: Explicit incorrect alternative associated with more harmful revision than neutral reconsideration for this sample and fixed panel.
interpretation_rules.ci_spans_zero: Study does not resolve the sign; do not claim no effect or equivalence.
interpretation_rules.ci_below_zero: Report unexpected lower directed harmful revision without changing analysis.
interpretation_rules.half_width_over_0_075: Report realized precision poorer than prospectively intended.

invalidity: Invalid initial makes both branches structurally ineligible; invalid final excluded from valid-pair primary and reported separately; no scientific invalid resampling.
